configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: The verification build. Sanitized per D4. g++-12 is the floor D28 set: the system c++ on Ubuntu 22.04 is 11.4 and cannot build std::expected. Reasoning in SYSTEM-DESIGN.md D31.

configurePresets.name: debug-g++-13
configurePresets.displayName: Debug on g++-13 (mirrors the CI matrix)
configurePresets.description: Exists so a CI-only failure can be reproduced by name. Ubuntu 22.04 has no g++-13 candidate, so this WILL fail on that machine with a compiler-not-found error. That is expected, not a broken preset.

configurePresets.name: bench
configurePresets.description: Measurement only. The binaries refuse to run under a sanitizer or with assertions enabled (D17), so a wrong number cannot be produced by accident from either direction.

testPresets.name: fast
testPresets.description: The edit loop. Excludes the `gate` LABEL, which is the opt-out CMakeLists.txt documents - not a name regex, which would also swallow any future test merely named *_gate_*.

testPresets.name: all
testPresets.description: What CI runs on pull requests and nightly, and what must pass before tagging.
